issues.description: Condition scale modifiers (GOOD=1.0, FAIR=1.3, POOR=1.6) are lower than masonry wall RP (1.0/1.5/2.0) based on engineering judgment, not field calibration. Foundation is smaller scope at ground level, but actual RP condition impact has not been measured.
issues.suggested_fix: Flag for field calibration on first 3 foundation RP projects. Compare actual vs estimated prep time. Adjust modifiers if needed.
issues.notes: Low risk — foundation is small scope so even if modifiers are slightly off, total time impact is small. Validation plan VP-002 covers this.
